attempt_summaries.rationale: Added securityContext with runAsNonRoot:true, runAsUser:1000, allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, readOnlyRootFilesystem:true to fix BG005, BG006, BG009 while keeping existing volume mounts functional.
Added CPU request to satisfy kube-linter unset-cpu-requirements; kept all security fields as they already meet BG005/BG006/BG009.

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: thumbnailer
  namespace: media
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: thumbnailer
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: thumbnailer
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: thumbnailer
          image: ghcr.io/example/thumbnailer:0.9.1
          args: ["--listen=:9000", "--cache=/var/cache/app"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 9000
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 128Mi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
            - name: cache
              mountPath: /var/cache/app
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: cache
          emptyDir: {}
